schema.description: The status of a job, which the controller computes from what each agent did: submitted, processing, completed, failed, partial_failure (completed on some agents and failed on others) or skipped (each agent skipped it).
schema.title: JobStatus

parameters.description: Maximum number of jobs per page (1-100).
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Number of jobs to skip for pagination.
parameters.name: offset
